name: Cameras — OpenCam Console
description: Fleet console for OpenCam cameras (Thingino) over MQTT: inventory from hello/state, online/offline, event log, and remote control — PTZ pad with deadman, stream start/stop and HD, snapshot, voice test and reboot — plus the microSD config.ini for provisioning.

configSchema.label: MQTT base topic
configSchema.help: Topic root of the cameras: must match the firmware's mqtt.base_topic (opencam/%device).

configSchema.label: Offline after (seconds)
configSchema.help: Mark a camera offline when no live traffic arrives within this window (a backstop beyond the MQTT LWT). Should be ~3 state intervals.

configSchema.label: Command expiry (seconds)
configSchema.help: `exp` sent with every command: a camera drops a command that arrives later (code expired). StreamHub times it out after exp + 10 s without an answer.

configSchema.label: Long command timeout (seconds)
configSchema.help: How long an accepted long command (reboot, firmware upgrade, ini reset) may stay in progress before it is marked timeout.

configSchema.label: State history points per camera
configSchema.help: How many recent state samples (RSSI, memory, load, queue, SD) to keep per camera for the charts.

configSchema.label: Events kept per camera
configSchema.help: Size of the per-camera event log ring.

configSchema.label: HD revert (minutes)
configSchema.help: The HD button switches the camera to its main stream; it goes back to the sub-stream after this many minutes.

configSchema.label: Broker URL for cameras
configSchema.help: What the cameras dial (written into config.ini). Empty = the app's mqtt.url.

configSchema.label: Default RTMP URL for cameras
configSchema.help: Stream URL written into config.ini when a camera has none of its own.

configSchema.label: config.ini uses the app's broker credentials
configSchema.help: Lab setups only: write the app's own MQTT user/password into config.ini instead of the per-camera credential.

name: Cockpit
description: CCTV-style surveillance board: a paginated, drag-and-drop grid of every live stream in the app.

name: Counting — Line-Crossing People Counter
description: Counts people crossing tagged lines (YOLO11 + ByteTrack): IN/OUT + live occupancy — co-located or distributed per-stream on edge nodes.

configSchema.label: Inference device
configSchema.help: Where the model runs. Edge nodes advertise their own GPU capacity.

configSchema.label: Sample FPS
configSchema.help: Fixed sampling cadence (3.5 is the counting default — a person must appear on both sides of the line).

configSchema.label: Detection confidence
configSchema.help: Minimum person-detection confidence (0–1) applied when a line does not override it.

name: Crowd — Density Threshold
description: Periodic head-count per polygon zone with a multi-cycle threshold alert — co-located or distributed per-stream on edge nodes.

configSchema.label: Inference device
configSchema.help: Where the model runs. Edge nodes advertise their own GPU capacity.

configSchema.label: Sample FPS
configSchema.help: Snapshot cadence for the head-count pipeline.

configSchema.label: Detection confidence
configSchema.help: Minimum detection confidence (0–1) applied when a zone does not override it.

name: Deface — Face Obfuscation
description: Detects faces in the app's live stream (CenterFace) and obfuscates them on the player: blur, mosaic or solid mask over each face.

configSchema.label: Room / stream
configSchema.help: HLS room name to process — /hls/<app>/<room>/index.m3u8.

configSchema.label: Detection threshold
configSchema.help: Face detection sensitivity (0–1). Lower catches more faces but adds false positives; raise it if too much is masked.

configSchema.label: Anonymization method
configSchema.help: How the player masks each detected face region.

configSchema.label: Mask scale
configSchema.help: Enlarge detected boxes by this factor to cover hair/chin (deface --mask-scale).

configSchema.label: Rectangular masks
configSchema.help: On masks with rectangles; off uses ellipses (deface default).

configSchema.label: Mosaic block size
configSchema.help: Pixel size of mosaic blocks — only used when method is 'mosaic'.

configSchema.label: Detection downscale
configSchema.help: WxH to downscale frames for detection (empty = native). Smaller is much faster on CPU at a small accuracy cost (deface --scale).

configSchema.label: Use CUDA (GPU)
configSchema.help: On uses the CUDA execution provider (needs onnxruntime-gpu); off runs on CPU. Falls back to CPU automatically when CUDA is unavailable.

configSchema.label: Sample FPS
configSchema.help: Frames per second to sample from the stream (lower = less CPU).

configSchema.label: Draw detection scores
configSchema.help: Show the confidence score next to each mask (debugging).

name: Demography — Age / Gender / Emotion
description: Per-face age / gender / emotion reads (InsightFace, or an opt-in vision-API engine) — co-located or distributed per-stream on edge nodes.

configSchema.label: Inference device
configSchema.help: Where the model runs. Edge nodes advertise their own GPU capacity.

configSchema.label: Demography engine
configSchema.help: Local by default. An API engine sends periodic snapshots to that provider.

configSchema.label: Vision-API key (openai / deepseek engines)
configSchema.help: Only used when the engine is an external API. Never sent to edge nodes in an assignment frame.

configSchema.label: Sample FPS
configSchema.help: Snapshot cadence for the demography pipeline.

configSchema.label: Detection confidence
configSchema.help: Minimum face-detection confidence (0–1).

name: Fixture App
description: Synthetic exportable worker app for the export vectors.

name: Fleet — Agent Management
description: Connect to the StreamHub Agents in this app over MQTT: live health (CPU/RAM/temp/uptime/cameras/disk/battery), online/offline status, a configurable battery-low alert, and remote control — restart, OTA update, config push and ping.

configSchema.label: Offline after (seconds)
configSchema.help: Mark an agent offline when no telemetry arrives within this window (a backstop beyond the MQTT LWT). Should be a few telemetry intervals.

configSchema.label: History points per agent
configSchema.help: How many recent telemetry samples to keep per agent for the charts.

configSchema.label: Command timeout (seconds)
configSchema.help: How long a command stays "pending" before the UI treats it as timed out (the agent still reports late results if it recovers).

configSchema.label: Battery-low alert threshold (percent)
configSchema.help: 0 disables the alert. Most fleet hosts run on mains and never report a battery at all — they are silently skipped, not treated as 0%. Fires fleet.battery_low / fleet.battery_recovered (10 points of hysteresis) through the same callback/MQTT/notifier funnel as every other alert family.

name: Live Control
description: Pause, resume or finish an already-live stream: viewers see a configured cover (image, looping video or text card) with audio muted until you resume.

configSchema.label: Default cover mode
configSchema.help: What a paused/finished stream shows when no per-stream override is given.

configSchema.label: Mute audio server-side while paused
configSchema.help: Also mute the publisher audio in LiveKit (best-effort), not just in our players.

configSchema.label: Overlay poll interval (seconds)
configSchema.help: How often the viewer overlay re-checks the public state (a data-channel push is instant).

name: Live Control Overlay
description: Shows the Live Control cover (image, looping video or text card) to viewers while a stream is paused or finished. Pairs with the Live Control console.

configSchema.label: Show a "finished" badge on the final card

name: LPR — License Plate Recognition
description: Reads license plates from the app's live stream (fast-alpr: YOLOv9 detector + ONNX OCR, open-source), matches them against a whitelist/blacklist and emits plate.detected/allowed/denied events.

configSchema.label: Room / stream
configSchema.help: HLS room to analyze — /hls/<app>/<room>/index.m3u8.

configSchema.label: Plate detector model
configSchema.help: fast-alpr ONNX plate detectors (MIT). Bigger input = more accurate, slower on CPU.

configSchema.label: OCR model
configSchema.help: fast-plate-ocr ONNX models (MIT), trained on global plate formats.

configSchema.label: Min OCR confidence
configSchema.help: Reads below this average character confidence are dropped (0–1).

configSchema.label: Sample FPS
configSchema.help: Frames per second to sample (2–4 is plenty for a gate camera).

configSchema.label: Dedupe window (seconds)
configSchema.help: The same plate seen again within this window is ONE event (a car idling at the gate does not spam the webhook). 0 = every read emits.

configSchema.label: Whitelist plates
configSchema.help: Comma/newline-separated plates that fire plate.allowed (normalized: case/separator-insensitive). Empty = no whitelist events.

configSchema.label: Blacklist plates
configSchema.help: Comma/newline-separated plates that fire plate.denied. A plate on both lists is treated as DENIED (blacklist wins).

configSchema.label: Direct callback URL
configSchema.help: Optional extra POST target for every event (e.g. a barrier opener). Events ALWAYS also flow through the app's signed callbacks.

configSchema.label: Save snapshots
configSchema.help: Save a JPEG frame per event under <appDir>/lpr/snapshots/.

configSchema.label: Use CUDA (GPU)
configSchema.help: On uses the CUDA execution provider (needs onnxruntime-gpu); off runs on CPU — fast-alpr is CPU-friendly at gate-camera FPS.

name: Occupancy — Zone Dwell & Sessions
description: Tracks people in per-stream polygon zones (YOLO11 + ByteTrack) and emits dwell sessions + over-limit alerts — co-located or distributed on edge nodes.

configSchema.label: Inference device
configSchema.help: Where the model runs. Edge nodes advertise their own GPU capacity.

configSchema.label: Sample FPS
configSchema.help: Fixed sampling cadence for the tracking pipeline.

configSchema.label: Detection confidence
configSchema.help: Minimum detection confidence (0–1) applied when a zone does not override it.

name: People Counter
description: Counts people crossing a line drawn on the live video (YOLOv8 + ByteTrack): IN/OUT totals, live occupancy and a capacity alert, with signed count.in/count.out/occupancy.limit webhooks.

configSchema.label: Room / stream
configSchema.help: HLS room name to count — /hls/<app>/<room>/index.m3u8.

configSchema.label: "In" side of the line
configSchema.help: Which side of the drawn line is INSIDE: crossing onto it counts as IN, leaving it counts as OUT. The tab shows it as a rotatable/flippable arrow on the video.

configSchema.label: Capacity alert threshold
configSchema.help: Fires one occupancy.limit event when occupancy reaches this; re-arms when it drops below. 0 disables the alert.

configSchema.label: Sample FPS
configSchema.help: Frames per second to sample. 3–5 is the CPU sweet spot: a person must appear on both sides of the line to count.

configSchema.label: Use CUDA (GPU)
configSchema.help: On uses the GPU; off runs on CPU (yolov8n + low FPS there).

configSchema.label: Detection confidence
configSchema.help: Minimum person-detection confidence (0–1).

configSchema.label: Events callback URL
configSchema.help: Where count.in / count.out / occupancy.limit events are POSTed (signed like app callbacks). Empty = counts stay local (SQLite + live panel).

configSchema.label: Callback signing secret
configSchema.help: HMAC-SHA256 secret for X-StreamHub-Signature on event POSTs (same verification as app callbacks). Empty = unsigned.

name: Perimeter — Intrusion Detection
description: Watches restricted zones on a live camera and, while armed (schedule or manual), alerts on any person inside them — with snapshot + clip evidence and an acknowledgeable alert queue.

configSchema.label: Room / camera
configSchema.help: HLS room to watch — /hls/<app>/<room>/index.m3u8.

configSchema.label: Restricted zones (JSON)
configSchema.help: Normalized 0-1 rects/polygons — draw them in the Perimeter tab instead of editing this by hand.

configSchema.label: Arming
configSchema.help: The dashboard arm/disarm toggle writes this field.

configSchema.label: Armed window (daily)
configSchema.help: HH:MM-HH:MM local time, wraps past midnight. Empty = weekends only.

configSchema.label: Armed all weekend
configSchema.help: Arms all day Saturday + Sunday in addition to the daily window.

configSchema.label: Schedule timezone
configSchema.help: IANA name the schedule is evaluated in. Empty = host local time (usually UTC inside Docker — set this for on-site wall-clock arming).

configSchema.label: Person confidence
configSchema.help: Minimum detection confidence (0-1) to count a person.

configSchema.label: Sample FPS
configSchema.help: 1-2 fps is the honest CPU budget; more needs CUDA.

configSchema.label: Per-zone cooldown (s)
configSchema.help: Seconds before the SAME zone may alert again (anti alert-storm).

configSchema.label: Evidence clip length (s)
configSchema.help: Copies the last HLS segments (-c copy, cheap) next to the snapshot; 0 disables the clip.

configSchema.label: Use CUDA (GPU)
configSchema.help: On uses the GPU; off runs on CPU. stream01 has no GPU — leave off there.

configSchema.label: Alert webhook URL
configSchema.help: Optional: every perimeter.intrusion event is POSTed here (in addition to the dashboard alert queue).

configSchema.label: Webhook HMAC secret
configSchema.help: When set, events are signed into X-StreamHub-Signature (sha256=<hex>) exactly like the app signed callbacks.

configSchema.label: Acknowledged through (ts)
configSchema.help: Managed by the alert queue panel — alerts at or before this unix timestamp are marked acknowledged on worker start.

name: Presence — Workstation Monitoring
description: Detects people in configured zones of the live stream and fires absence / return / after-hours events (signed app callbacks + webhook), with a zone editor and per-zone occupancy timeline.

configSchema.label: Room / stream
configSchema.help: HLS room name to monitor — /hls/<app>/<room>/index.m3u8.

configSchema.label: Zones (JSON)
configSchema.help: Normalized rectangles ([0-1] fractions of the frame): [{id,name,x,y,w,h}]. Draw them visually in the Presence tab.

configSchema.label: Work schedule
configSchema.help: HH:MM-HH:MM work window. A person present outside it fires presence.after_hours. Empty disables after-hours detection; start > end spans midnight (e.g. 22:00-06:00).

configSchema.label: Work days
configSchema.help: Days the schedule applies: 'mon-fri', 'mon,wed,fri', … Empty = all.

configSchema.label: Timezone
configSchema.help: IANA timezone for the schedule. Empty = server local time.

configSchema.label: Absence threshold (minutes)
configSchema.help: A zone continuously empty longer than this fires presence.absent.

configSchema.label: After-hours detection
configSchema.help: Fire presence.after_hours when someone is present outside the schedule.

configSchema.label: Use CUDA (GPU)
configSchema.help: On uses the GPU; off runs on CPU (yolov8n @2fps is CPU-viable).

configSchema.label: Confidence threshold
configSchema.help: Minimum person-detection confidence (0-1).

configSchema.label: Sample FPS
configSchema.help: Frames per second to sample (lower = less CPU; 2 is plenty).

configSchema.label: External webhook (optional)
configSchema.help: Extra raw-JSON POST target for every presence event. The app's signed callbacks fire regardless — leave empty to use only those.

name: Quality / Stream Health
description: Measure the client↔server connection quality: a download/upload bandwidth test plus latency/jitter, distilled into a green/amber/red traffic light against configurable thresholds.

configSchema.label: Green: min download (Mbps)
configSchema.help: At or above this download speed the light is green (optimal).

configSchema.label: Amber: min download (Mbps)
configSchema.help: Between amber and green thresholds the light is amber; below it, red.

configSchema.label: Target stream bitrate (kbps)
configSchema.help: Expected outbound/received stream bitrate. The measured reception bitrate is graded against this (green ≥ target, amber ≥ half).

configSchema.label: Green: max latency (ms)
configSchema.help: Round-trip time (and derived jitter) at or below this stays green.

configSchema.label: Download test URL
configSchema.help: Same-origin asset re-fetched (cache-busted) to measure download throughput. Point at a larger static file for steadier numbers.

configSchema.label: Download test size (MB)
configSchema.help: Total bytes to pull before computing the download speed.

configSchema.label: Upload test URL (optional)
configSchema.help: Optional endpoint that ACCEPTS a POST body (e.g. an S3 presigned URL). Leave blank to skip the upload leg — no browser-only test can measure upload without a server that reads the body.

name: Radio
description: Audio-only WebRTC radio inside the app: go on air from the mic, watch the live listener count and hand out subscribe-only listen tokens.

configSchema.label: Room name
configSchema.help: LiveKit room the máster publishes to and listeners subscribe from.

configSchema.label: Listen token TTL (seconds)
configSchema.help: Lifetime of generated subscribe-only listener tokens.

name: Safety PPE Monitor
description: EXPERIMENTAL: detects persons without helmet / hi-viz vest in configured work zones during work hours (pretrained YOLOv8 PPE model, community weights) and records ppe.violation events with evidence snapshots. Advisory only — not a certified safety system.

configSchema.label: Room / stream
configSchema.help: HLS room name to monitor — /hls/<app>/<room>/index.m3u8.

configSchema.label: Require helmet
configSchema.help: Flag persons without a hard hat.

configSchema.label: Require safety vest
configSchema.help: Flag persons without a hi-viz vest.

configSchema.label: Work zones (JSON)
configSchema.help: JSON array of {name, rect:[x,y,w,h]} with 0–1 frame-relative coordinates. Empty = one full-frame zone "all". A person belongs to a zone when their feet (bottom-center of the box) are inside it. The plugin tab has a visual editor for this field.

configSchema.label: Work hours
configSchema.help: HH:MM-HH:MM window (host local time) when PPE rules apply; overnight ranges wrap. Empty or malformed = always on (fail open).

configSchema.label: Work days
configSchema.help: Days the rules apply: names ('mon-fri', 'mon,wed') or ISO numbers ('1-5', 1=Monday). Empty = every day.

configSchema.label: Sustain frames
configSchema.help: A violation fires only after being seen in MORE THAN this many consecutive analyzed frames (default 3 → fires on the 4th), filtering single-frame detection noise.

configSchema.label: Cooldown (seconds)
configSchema.help: After a violation fires, the same zone + missing item cannot re-fire for this long.

configSchema.label: Detection confidence
configSchema.help: Minimum model confidence for person/PPE detections (0–1).

configSchema.label: Association threshold
configSchema.help: Fraction of a PPE item box that must lie inside a person box to count as worn by that person (containment, not IoU).

configSchema.label: Sample FPS
configSchema.help: Frames per second to analyze. The YOLOv8m model costs ~1 s of one CPU core per frame — keep this at 1 or below on CPU hosts.

configSchema.label: Use CUDA (GPU)
configSchema.help: On uses the CUDA execution provider (needs onnxruntime-gpu); off runs on CPU. Falls back to CPU automatically when CUDA is unavailable.

configSchema.label: Violation webhook URL
configSchema.help: Optional: POST each ppe.violation event {event, app, room, ts, zone, missing, confidence, snapshot_path} to this URL.

configSchema.label: Webhook HMAC secret
configSchema.help: Optional: signs the webhook body as X-StreamHub-Signature: sha256=<hmac> — the same format the core app callbacks use.

configSchema.label: Model URL (ONNX)
configSchema.help: ONNX checkpoint downloaded once into <DATA_DIR>/models/safety-ppe/. Swap for a custom YOLOv8 PPE export (class names are read from the ONNX metadata).

name: Scheduled Live
description: Schedule live premieres: viewers see a countdown until the start time, then the stream is revealed.

name: Stream Health Monitor
description: Validates ORIGIN stream quality per room: packet loss/discontinuities, audio silence, A/V desync, stalls and bitrate drops — sampled with ffprobe (no full decode), alerting through webhooks/MQTT/Streamflow.

configSchema.label: Sample interval (s)
configSchema.help: How often each stream is probed. Cost per stream per sample is one ffprobe + one audio-only decode of a single segment (<1% of a core at the default).

configSchema.label: Silence threshold (dBFS)
configSchema.help: Mean segment volume at or below this counts as silent.

configSchema.label: Silence duration (s)
configSchema.help: Continuous silence longer than this fires health.audio_lost.

configSchema.label: A/V desync threshold (ms)
configSchema.help: Audio-vs-video timestamp drift beyond this fires health.av_desync.

configSchema.label: Stall threshold (s)
configSchema.help: No new HLS segment for this long fires health.stalled (critical).

configSchema.label: Bitrate drop (%)
configSchema.help: Measured bitrate falling below this percentage of the rolling baseline marks the stream degraded. 0 disables the check.

configSchema.label: Recovery samples
configSchema.help: Consecutive clean samples required before health.recovered fires (hysteresis against flapping).

name: Streamflow — Workflow Engine
description: Chain boxes to turn any StreamHub event into an automation: trigger on a domain event, snapshot the room, analyze it with ChatGPT/DeepSeek, branch on the result, then notify / emit / store — a visual n8n-style builder.

configSchema.label: AI provider
configSchema.help: OpenAI-compatible /v1/chat/completions provider used by action.ai boxes.

configSchema.label: AI API key
configSchema.help: API key for the selected provider. Stored as a secret, never returned in clear. Falls back to the SecretsStore ref of the same name.

configSchema.label: AI model
configSchema.help: Model id, e.g. gpt-4o-mini (OpenAI) or deepseek-chat (DeepSeek).

configSchema.label: Monthly AI budget (USD)
configSchema.help: Hard cap on estimated AI spend per calendar month for this app. When reached, action.ai boxes fail closed until the next month.

configSchema.label: Max runs / minute
configSchema.help: Per-app rate limit so a hot event cannot flood the engine. Extra triggers within the window are dropped (logged).

configSchema.label: Enable execution nodes (code / ssh / shell / db)
configSchema.help: DANGER: allows workflows to run a Node.js snippet (node:vm sandbox), a shell command, an SSH command, or a SQL query ON THE SERVER. OFF by default; when off these boxes are hidden from the palette and refused at run time. node:vm is a guardrail, NOT a hard security boundary — only enable for trusted operators.

name: Timestamp CCTV
description: Overlay a live CCTV-style date/time stamp (with the camera name) on the player. Configure format, corner, colour and whether to show the name.

configSchema.label: Text colour
configSchema.help: Hex colour for the overlay text (e.g. #ffffff, #00e5ff).

name: Video Streaming
description: Go live with your webcam + mic and forward the composed room to an RTMP destination (YouTube, Twitch, …) via server egress.

configSchema.label: Room name
configSchema.help: LiveKit room the webcam publishes to and the egress composes.

configSchema.label: Default RTMP URL
configSchema.help: Optional. Pre-fills the destination field (rtmp:// or rtmps://).

name: Vidstack Player
description: Swap the built-in video.js HLS + VOD player for an advanced, skinned Vidstack player (hls.js). Sub-second WebRTC live is unaffected.

configSchema.label: Autoplay on load
configSchema.help: Muted autoplay to satisfy browser policies; viewers can unmute.

name: VOD Transcription
description: Transcribes recorded VODs to text + SRT subtitles (uploaded next to the recording in S3). Local open-source Whisper by default; OpenAI API optional.

configSchema.label: Transcription engine
configSchema.help: local runs on this server via the plugin worker (no external calls, no API cost); openai sends the extracted audio to the OpenAI API.

configSchema.label: Whisper model (local)
configSchema.help: Only used by the local engine; auto-downloaded on first use.

configSchema.label: OpenAI model
configSchema.help: Only used when the engine is openai. Models without segment timestamps yield a single full-length SRT cue.

configSchema.label: Language
configSchema.help: ISO code of the spoken language; 'auto' detects it.

configSchema.label: Transcribe new VODs automatically
configSchema.help: On: every recording is transcribed as soon as its VOD is ready. Off: transcribe on demand (POST /apps/:app/vods/:id/transcribe).

configSchema.label: OpenAI API key
configSchema.help: Required only when the engine is openai.

name: Watermark
description: Overlay a text watermark on the player.

name: YOLO Object Detection
description: Runs a YOLO worker over the app's live stream, detecting COCO objects and POSTing bounding boxes to a callback URL.

configSchema.label: Room / stream
configSchema.help: HLS room name to analyze — /hls/<app>/<room>/index.m3u8.

configSchema.label: Use CUDA (GPU)
configSchema.help: On uses the GPU; off runs on CPU. stream01 has no GPU — leave off there.

configSchema.label: Callback URL
configSchema.help: POST {app, room, ts, detections:[{class,conf,bbox}]} per frame.

configSchema.label: Confidence threshold
configSchema.help: Minimum detection confidence (0–1).

configSchema.label: Sample FPS
configSchema.help: Frames per second to sample from the stream (lower = less CPU).

configSchema.label: Classes filter
configSchema.help: Comma-separated COCO class names to keep; empty detects all.
